title: Gateways and worker fleets
excerpt: Gateways and worker fleets A gateway — a proxy, a worker pool, any process that fronts one MCP server with many short lived clients — probes the server once and reuses the answer for every connection after it. Connect with a prior discover result connect() takes an optional prior: a cached era verdict (PriorDiscovery).
